presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Near-maximum lengths: long party names and roles, case file, titles, stage captions, prop labels and a long callout; three allegations, three sections and five day labels. Coordinator decision (standing stress rule, AUTHORING item 20, 2026-09-26): counts and the longest texts are capped to the largest values found to keep every ratio at text >= 16 px and people at head >= 52 px at 16:9 and 9:16 (1080p, the story floor of LAW-0249) and >= 45 px at 1:1 (the stress floor of LAW-0251 / LAW-0447: at 1:1 the text column's width, set by its height, bounds the stage) — allegations 4 → 3 and sections 4 → 3 (the fourth allegation and section are dropped), each allegation shortened by dropping its ' (supplied)' suffix (≈ 55 → 37–42 characters), section labels ≈ 50 → 34–40 characters, day labels 7 → 5 (the baseline count), and the callout 86 → 57 characters. Party names and roles, the case file, titles, stage captions and prop labels keep their near-maximum lengths. True driver: the text column's height at 1:1 and 9:16 (every supplied text is printed there once the props are drawn without text) against the figure floor. Measured with the uncapped values (DOM-less layout estimate): 1:1 nothing fits (stage and column both overflow), 9:16 head ≈ 38 px. Measured (rendered) with the capped values: heads 75 / 57 / 46 px at 16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1. Tried first: a two-level split stage, shorter party roles (no gain at 1:1), a stacked column at 1:1, a hanging board over the desk (adopted for 1:1 and 9:16), wider columns (0.36 / 0.42 of the width) and callouts beside the column instead of across it.
